# fptcloud_backup_native_vm_restore_points (Data Source)

Lists the restore points of a VM, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_backup_native_vm_restore_points" "web" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  vm_id  = var.web_instance_id
}

output "latest_restore_point" {
  value = data.fptcloud_backup_native_vm_restore_points.web.restore_points[0].created_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) ID of the VM.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `restore_points` (List of Object) Restore points, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restore_points))

<a id="nestedatt--restore_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restore_points`

Read-Only:

- `backup_job_id` (String)
- `backup_job_name` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `is_available` (Boolean)
- `is_incremental` (Boolean)
- `size` (Number)
